headlines.title: Amazon partners with OpenAI to let users of Amazon's DSP run ads in ChatGPT in a pilot program limited to the US; ChatGPT Ads hit $1B in ARR last month (Peter Adams/Marketing Dive)
Paris-based Arlequin AI, which is developing proprietary models based on topological neural networks, raised a €28M Series A co-led by redalpine and OTB (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
General Robotics, led by Microsoft vets, says its AI has cut robot setup from a month to hours
Mistral AI Raises $3.5B At $24B Valuation In Another Record European AI Round
TAR, which builds off-grid power systems for data centers, raised a $120M Series A led by Spark Capital at a ~$1B valuation (Mark Chediak/Bloomberg)
Positron, which is designing an AI processor called Asimov with a "memory-first architecture" and up to 2.3TB of memory, raised $875M at a $5B valuation (Robbie Whelan/Wall Street Journal)
Mach Industries, which makes unmanned military vehicles and weapons, raised $600M in an extension to its $300M Series C, doubling its valuation to $3.7B (Julie Bort/TechCrunch)
Ant International, Visa, and Mastercard plan a new standard for payments made via AI agents, citing McKinsey's projection of $3T to $5T in commerce by 2030 (Evelyn Cheng/CNBC)
Amazon’s new board member is a cybersecurity founder who sold his last company to Google for $5.4B
Uber invests $10M in Indian fleet operator Carrum at $168M valuation
Cognition hits $48B valuation, signaling investors believe AI coding is far from a winner-take-all market
Maven Robotics, whose wheeled robots travel up to 10 mph and lift up to 30kg using two arms, emerges from stealth after raising $100M (Tim Fernholz/TechCrunch)
Antioch raises $32m to test robots in simulation before they touch hardware
OpenAI’s Bubeck denies trying to cut Anthropic mathematician from credit
UK will legislate to make Apple and Google block nude images for children
Google signs its biggest rice-methane carbon credit deal with Indian startup Mitti Labs
Celero raises $275m to bring coherent optics inside AI data centres
Nasdaq invests $100M in Kraken parent company Payward, valuing the crypto exchange at $21B; in March, Kraken said it will distribute Nasdaq's tokenized stocks (Katherine Doherty/Bloomberg)
29 Companies Joined The Unicorn Board In August, Led By AI Software And Semiconductors
Exclusive: Bynario raises €2.1m to tackle cybersecurity’s AI slop problem
Prime-time AI: Microsoft Copilot gets a share of the spotlight during Seahawks’ season opener
NLM Photonics adds key investors in quest to reduce the power needed to move data between chips
Six Chinese AI firms accused of aggressively copying US frontier models
Apple starts preorders for Watch Series 12, Ultra 4 with new Health Sensing System
